title: Amata cucumber (Amata F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: Amata cucumber is an F1 hybrid cucumber variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Amata cucumber is an F1 hybrid cucumber variety, also sold or known as Amata F1. It is not on the NSIC registry, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Allied Botanical (Condor).

heroImage.alt: Ampalaya seedlings planted through plastic mulch on raised beds, the kind of farm where Amata cucumber is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Amata F1, this is the same cucumber. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [cucumber variety finder](/crop-varieties/cucumber), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for gourds and melons](/land-preparation/cucurbit-land-preparation).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

The registry gives no day count or trial yield for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit cucumber fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [damping off](/diseases/damping-off), [downy mildew of cucurbits](/diseases/downy-mildew), [leafminer](/pests/leafminer), [melon fly](/pests/melon-fly). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Days to harvest:** First harvest 40 to 45 days after sowing.
**Fruit:** Firm cylinders, medium green with white blotches, about 230 g.
Intermediate resistance to pests and diseases (company wording).

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: allied Botanical's tropical (Asian type) cucumber, only evidence is the company's own lineup. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual cucumber on the same ground.
Where and when to plant Amata cucumber

Cucumber gives its first fruit fast, often in five to six weeks. Pick a variety bred to tolerate downy mildew if you plant near the rains. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.

items.q: Is Amata F1 the same as Amata?
items.a: Yes. Amata F1 is another name for Amata. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Amata?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
